# unifi_nat_rule (Resource)

**Experimental.** Manages a user-defined NAT rule (Settings > Policy Table > NAT): masquerade, source NAT or destination NAT. The schema follows the UniFi Network 11.0.99 UI and has not been validated against a rule imported from a console yet.

The automatic per-WAN "NAT masquerade" rows the policy table shows are not NAT rules: the UI builds them from the network configuration, and they are controlled by `unifi_setting_global_nat` (`mode`, `excluded_network_ids`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental. Forward TCP 8443 on the WAN to 10.0.10.20:443.
resource "unifi_nat_rule" "https_to_server" {
  description  = "https to server"
  type         = "DNAT"
  in_interface = "<wan networkconf id>"
  protocol     = "tcp"
  ip_address   = "10.0.10.20"
  port         = "443"

  destination_filter = {
    filter_type = "ADDRESS_AND_PORT"
    port        = "8443"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The rule name shown in the policy table.
- `type` (String) `MASQUERADE`, `SNAT` or `DNAT`.

### Optional

- `destination_filter` (Attributes) Destination match. Defaults to matching anything (`filter_type = "NONE"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_filter))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `exclude` (Boolean) Exclude matching traffic from NAT. Defaults to `false`.
- `in_interface` (String) Inbound interface (network ID) for `DNAT` rules.
- `ip_address` (String) Translated IP address (`SNAT`/`DNAT`).
- `ip_version` (String) `IPV4` (default) or `IPV6`.
- `logging` (Boolean) Syslog logging. Defaults to `false`.
- `out_interface` (String) Outbound interface (network ID) for `MASQUERADE`/`SNAT` rules.
- `port` (String) Translated port (`DNAT`).
- `pppoe_use_base_interface` (Boolean) On a PPPoE WAN, use the underlying interface. Defaults to `false`.
- `protocol` (String) `all` (default), `tcp`, `udp` or `tcp_udp`.
- `rule_index` (Number) Evaluation order; assigned by the controller when unset.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `source_filter` (Attributes) Source match. Defaults to matching anything (`filter_type = "NONE"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--destination_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_filter`

Required:

- `filter_type` (String) `NONE`, `ADDRESS_AND_PORT` (`address` and/or `port`), `NETWORK_CONF` (`network_conf_id`) or `FIREWALL_GROUPS` (`firewall_group_ids`).

Optional:

- `address` (String) IP address, range or CIDR.
- `firewall_group_ids` (Set of String) Firewall group (port/address object) IDs.
- `invert_address` (Boolean) Match everything except `address`.
- `invert_port` (Boolean) Match everything except `port`.
- `network_conf_id` (String) Network (networkconf) ID.
- `port` (String) Port or port range.


<a id="nestedatt--source_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_filter`

Required:

- `filter_type` (String) `NONE`, `ADDRESS_AND_PORT` (`address` and/or `port`), `NETWORK_CONF` (`network_conf_id`) or `FIREWALL_GROUPS` (`firewall_group_ids`).

Optional:

- `address` (String) IP address, range or CIDR.
- `firewall_group_ids` (Set of String) Firewall group (port/address object) IDs.
- `invert_address` (Boolean) Match everything except `address`.
- `invert_port` (Boolean) Match everything except `port`.
- `network_conf_id` (String) Network (networkconf) ID.
- `port` (String) Port or port range.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site and the rule id: <site>:<id>
terraform import unifi_nat_rule.https_to_server default:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
